name: content.dndsheets.feat.grappler
description: Requires Strength 13. You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling, and you can use your action to try to pin it: if you succeed on another grapple check, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.alert
description: Proficiency in Initiative. You can add your proficiency bonus to Initiative rolls. Also, immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with that of a willing ally in the same combat; you can't do this if you or the ally is incapacitated.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.magic_initiate
description: You learn two cantrips from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list, and one level 1 spell from that same list, which you always have prepared. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot and regain that use when you finish a long rest; you can also cast it using normal spell slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat (chosen when you take it).

name: content.dndsheets.feat.savage_attacker
description: Once per turn, when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.skilled
description: You gain proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice, in any combination.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.archery
description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.defense
description: While you are wearing light, medium, or heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.great_weapon_fighting
description: When you roll damage for a melee weapon you are wielding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.two_weapon_fighting
description: When you make an extra attack from using a weapon with the light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_combat_prowess
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, when you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead; you can't use this again until the start of your next turn.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_dimensional_travel
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_fate
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, when you or a creature within 60 feet succeeds or fails on a d20 test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total as a bonus or penalty to that roll. You can't use this again until you roll Initiative or finish a short or long rest.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_irresistible_offense
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you deal always ignores resistance, and when you roll a 20 on an attack roll you can deal extra damage equal to the ability score increased by this feat, of the same type as the attack.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_spell_recall
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot of level 1 to 4, roll 1d4: if you roll the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_the_night_spirit
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, in dim light or darkness you can become invisible as a bonus action (the invisibility ends as soon as you take an action, a bonus action, or a reaction), and you have resistance to all damage except psychic and radiant.

name: content.dndsheets.feat.boon_of_truesight
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1. Also, you have truesight with a range of 60 feet.
